assets.title: Deep Floating-panel Picture Frame
assets.description: One original horizontal deep floating-panel picture frame, one static prop and one form only; the original plural frame-form family remains partial. A continuous 90 mm deep closed rectangular annulus and full 18 mm rear board surround an unpatterned 12 mm display panel. Four complete 40 by 40 mm rear spacers hold the panel 50 mm before the rear board. Real uninterrupted 30 mm air gaps separate every panel edge from the frame, and the front face is recessed 28 mm. Original fixed rear strut, two full pierced cheeks, complete finite stop and one continuous headed square pin provide explicit finite desktop-ground contacts with the complete lower frame edge. Three actual square through-bores retain complete walls and nonbearing air corridors; all finite contacts and whole empty/material domains require actual-geometry acceptance. Metres, native Z up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Four opaque unlinked constant Principled PBR colours, no texture nodes. Existing easel canvas, true mirror ring and comb frame are acknowledged, never imported or converted. No painting, design, glass, mirror, table, wall, extra variant or artwork. Visual static display only: no standard canvas or easel fit, conservation, moisture/light protection, folding, load, anti-tip, material, manufacture or safety claim.
